name: QueryThingModel

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If this ID value exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The resource group ID.

<notice>IoT Platform currently supports resource group management only at the instance level. The ResourceGroupId request parameter is no longer valid and does not need to be specified.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
资源组ID。

<notice>目前，物联网平台仅支持实例维度的资源组管理。请求参数ResourceGroupId配置已无效，无需再传入。
</notice>
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The version number of the TSL model to query.
Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150318.html to view the TSL model version numbers of a product.

If you do not specify this parameter, the TSL model feature definitions in draft status are queried. If you specify this parameter, the TSL model feature definitions of the specified version are queried
parameters.help_zh:
要查看的物模型版本号。
可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150318.html查看产品下的物模型版本号。

不传入此参数，则查询草稿状态的物模型功能定义；传入此参数，则查询指定版本的物模型功能定义
parameters.name: model_version

parameters.help_en:
The identifier of the custom TSL module, which is unique within the product.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default module data is queried
parameters.help_zh:
物模型自定义模块标识符，在产品中具有唯一性。

不传入此参数时，查询默认模块数据
parameters.name: function_block_id
